events.summary: Hey everybody! It’s been a long time coming but we can finally reveal Kitaria Fables 2, the next instalment in the beloved action-RPG series set in the magical world of Kitaria! Following the events of 2021’s Kitaria Fables, this direct sequel introduces two brand-new heroes, Alice Skylar and Dusty Tuftkin, as they join up with the Royal Academy Expedition Team on a mission to the remote Arkadera Peninsula.
